program.name: Strength Endurance
program.subject: Strength
program.blurb: Full-body supersets with moderate weights and higher reps, for strength that lasts.
program.about: Strength that lasts rather than strength for one rep. Full-body days pair a lower and an upper exercise in supersets with moderate weights and higher reps, and short rests keep the heart rate up. Two days alternate. Abs finish every session. Both later levels add reps, so by Level III the sets are long.
